questions.question: Q: How do you calculate the sample size for a stratum in stratified sampling?
questions.correctAnswer: Stratum sample size = (stratum size ÷ population size) × total sample size.
questions.explanation: Answer: Stratum sample size = (stratum size ÷ population size) × total sample size.
